music._authority: This block is the source of truth for the film's music. lib/build_render_props.py reads the beds from here and passes them to lib/mix_audio.py; renders/mix_report.json is the measured RESULT of this block, not a second opinion.
music.strategy: one bed per act group, crossfaded on the act boundary under the fade through black

levels.eq: highpass 120 Hz x2, high shelf -6 dB from 3.5 kHz (Q 0.7), lowpass 5 kHz x2
levels.bed_compressor: 2:1, attack 50ms, release 500ms, knee 6 dB, threshold from the bed's own loudness
levels.ducking: explicit gain envelope with 1.5s raised-cosine ramps in and out, anticipatory on the way out

music.brief: sparse ambient pads or sustained tones. Elevator-quiet.

selection.method: MUSIC_LIBRARY_DIR is not reachable in this session (unset, no .env, registry reports music_library UNAVAILABLE), so the playbook's own tier 2 was used: Pixabay Music on its three suggested queries plus three more in the same register. Six candidates were fetched and all six measured by scripts/measure_music.py and lib/music_brightness.py before any was assigned to an act.
selection.not_done: The playbook also asks for a 20-second audition of the shortlist, EQ'd and levelled as it will sit in the mix. This run is unattended and no audition by ear took place. The choice rests on the measurements alone and this says so.
